format: WSDC swing contests: event director/owner, chief judge, secondary chief judge, score person

source.quote_free_summary: The named functionaries (and director/owner spouses and children) must not compete in any swing contest at the event, with exceptions for non-judged contests and certain separate-organization contests; directors/owners and their immediate family may not perform chief judge or scoring duties.

requirement: Tier-2 check for chair and scorer in WSDC-declared events; the owner/director definition depends on OD-06.
interpretation_notes: Exceptions not modelled in slice 1 (fail closed, no override). "Event director/owner" has no DanceFlow role today (OD-06 undecided). Design only (PR-A): nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
